title: AI Consultant
description_html:
About the role

We help mid-size firms decide where AI is worth the effort.

What you'll do

  • Scope projects with clients; stakeholder management daily
  • Prototype applications of large language models in Python
  • Produce client reports; strong technical writing

What you bring

  • Machine learning fundamentals
  • Communication with non-technical clients

Nice to have

  • NLP
  • Azure
